stability_DSF.assay: DSF (differential scanning fluorimetry) -> melting temperature Tm
stability_DSF.criterion: variant Tm not meaningfully below the parent Tm (state the margin); flag any aggregation; combine with the developability liability scan (notebook 04)

specificity_panel.purpose: confirm the matured variant still prefers the intended antigen (no new off-target binding)
panel: a closely related off-target (e.g., a paralog/family member)
an irrelevant protein (e.g., BSA) as a non-specific-binding control
specificity_panel.criterion: variant binds the target but NOT the off-targets above the parent's background

decision: keep variants that (a) improve KD vs parent, (b) hold Tm, (c) add no developability liability, and (d) stay target-specific — the rest are de-prioritised, honestly reported.
